checks: Standalone Blazor WASM starts from static hosting with no renderer Node runtime or desktop path UI.
The actual OS folder picker grants a live external vault, including binary attachment inventory.
Real CodeMirror typing and Ctrl+S preserve exact UTF-8 BOM, CRLF and Unicode in the original file.
External LF/CRLF changes reconfigure CodeMirror without changing the next save's line-ending style.
The shared note-creation UI creates folders and writes a new Markdown note directly to disk.
Desktop-only plugins are unavailable and Node-dependent plugins fail visibly without executing past require.
Core enablement and the unchanged upstream sample plugin save settings into the selected vault.
Page reload reconnects an IndexedDB directory handle and restores layout, core state and exact disk content.
External edits refresh clean buffers; stale saves fail without overwriting disk or discarding unsaved text.
A real page reload is blocked while a buffer has unsaved changes.
Cancelling the native folder picker retains the selected vault and dirty buffer.
Vault switching isolates core settings, and Create vault creates a real subfolder in the selected parent.
A new vault required explicit community-plugin opt-in, stored separately without creating or resetting an enabled-ID file.
The unchanged pinned Excalidraw plugin loads through explicit persisted enablement and registers its real settings and commands.
The real Excalidraw creation command opens its unchanged drawing view and a nonzero-size canvas.
Real pointer/keyboard input creates and moves a rectangle; the original canvas undo and redo restore it.
The original Insert image command and fuzzy picker add a real vault PNG; the actual canvas file data decodes to the exact dimensions and center pixel while the source asset bytes remain unchanged.
The actual plugin Ctrl+S path persists the edited element identities, geometry and compressed scene to the real vault file.
The real plugin view closes without cleanup errors and reopens its physical compressed scene with the same element identities and edited geometry.
Actual File explorer input reopens the saved drawing through the unchanged plugin's normal navigation interception, not only a direct custom-view request.

A real-folder WASM reload/reconnect retains the edited compressed scene and saved leaf, restores vault-configured enablement and opens the actual drawing with unchanged element identities, geometry and file bytes.

Disabling the actual plugin closes and unloads its live drawing without cleanup errors, removes owned commands/settings/styles and retains unavailable pane state; re-enable creates a fresh real canvas with the same physical saved scene.

The unchanged Markdown postprocessor renders the real saved drawing and linked PNG inside a BOM/CRLF note; actual SVG paths and decoded image pixels are verified, Source and plugin disable remove the embed, and re-enable refreshes it without rewriting the note, drawing or asset.

The unchanged plugin opens a real cached GitHub drawing in enforced view mode, skips repeated background/force/explicit saves without acknowledging revisions, permits local settings, denies direct writes, closes cleanly and returns to the local vault with all remote blobs and local note/asset bytes unchanged.
inputEnvironment: Windows occlusion and renderer/timer background throttling disabled in disposable UI processes; production launch is unchanged.
